source: create me a cottage core, realistic indie core 3 story house showcase, include many details and features.

image_prompt.text: A three-story cottagecore house as the hero build, deliberately composed to be framed from the approach
Spawn oriented so the first thing a visitor sees is a composed shot of the house facade, never backstage geometry
A walkable three-story interior, since the house itself is the thing being showcased
Many small decorative details and features throughout the build

layout_placement.text: Spawn placed and oriented toward the composed reveal of the house
Small optional finds tucked off the walking route, rewarding visitors who explore the house further

notes: A walkable three-story interior would force P3 for the outside-inside transition and P2 for overhanging floors, but no option in the loaded file carries either, so the route stays P0.
Shape was a close call between the guided route and the free-roam space; a single house reads as free-roam.

open_questions.ask: Do you walk through the inside of the house, or is this an exterior showcase you walk around?
Is this just the house and its garden, or a wider plot of land around it?

coverage_missing.ask: Do you walk through the inside of the house, or is this an exterior showcase?
What features did you have in mind - furnished rooms, a garden, interactive props?

answers.ask: Do you walk through the inside of the house, or is this an exterior showcase you walk around?
answers.answer: Make it a walk-through house showcase with fully detailed, accessible interiors across all three stories.

answers.ask: Is this just the house and its garden, or a wider plot of land around it?
answers.answer: Keep it to the house and a small, detailed cottage garden around it so the showcase stays focused.
